title: AA Insight Outbox
description: A batch of insights a consumer app (e.g. ArtInsight) exports for the user to carry back to their home toolkit surface, consumed whole by librarian.importInsightOutbox (toolkit/core/librarian.js). Each insight still passes through the SAME grant-gated, never-silent importInsight path as a live cross-app insight — the outbox is only a transport, it grants nothing and applies nothing on its own. kind='aa-insight-outbox'; version 1 (documented here; importInsightOutbox does not yet reject a mismatched v — see protocol/README.md).

sourceAppId.description: The exporting app's id — MUST match an active grant's appId on the importing side, or every insight in the batch is refused with reason 'no-grant'.

change.description: Whitelisted inner change. op='profile-set' may only target a fields.* path (enforced by the engine's isSafeFieldsPath, not expressible in this shape-only schema); op='add-memory' carries a free-form record.
